seedance_schema.camera_movement: Named cinematic camera move (Pan, Tilt, Dolly Zoom, Orbital, FPV Drone, Crane, Tracking, etc.)
seedance_schema.motion_dynamics: List of physical motion effects applied to subject/scene
seedance_schema.motion_speed: Perceived playback speed relative to real time, including slow-mo/phantom-camera framing
seedance_schema.camera_lens_mm: Focal length carried over from the still reference for visual continuity between key visual and motion output
seedance_schema.lighting_transition: How the lighting evolves across the shot duration (static holds excluded)
seedance_schema.frame_rate_feel: Descriptive frame-rate/motion-blur character (not a literal encoder setting)
seedance_schema.temporal_pacing: Shot duration and edit rhythm: seamless loop vs. single narrative beat vs. punchy hero cut
seedance_schema.motion_intensity_default: Suggested 1-10 motion intensity default for this concept archetype, overridable via the UI slider
